adversarialTests: Reject rewriting the accepted source manifest to PROG-WP-001.
Reject treating historical wave-a as generic PASSAGE authority.
Reject any hidden path or any learner blob drift.
Reject any candidate artifact differing in either byte count or SHA-256.

compatibility.reason: The historical wave-a gate is not a generic transport gate: it requires PROG-WP-001 manifest authority and historical Wave A provenance. PASSAGE therefore gets an exact dedicated PR proof and an exact post-merge compatibility recognizer while legacy behavior is retained byte-for-byte.

invariants: All 25 learner paths retain the exact accepted e04 Git blob identities, including source_manifest.json.
The accepted artifact must remain exactly 583764 bytes with the frozen SHA-256.
The central Learn-it Next workflow remains byte-identical to base M.
The previous current runner is copied byte-identically to run_checks_legacy.py; the new run_checks.py delegates all non-PASSAGE cases to that legacy copy.
PASSAGE post-merge recognition is exact-shape only and fail-closed.
No V6/factory authority, contract, governor state, release, deployment or PROGRAM_STATELOG path changes.
GitHub main remains the sole executable product authority.
nonGoals: Changing PROGRAM_STATELOG or PASSAGE governor closeout.
purpose: Merge the already accepted PASSAGE learner closure onto current V6 product authority without rewriting its historical source manifest, while adding the smallest CI compatibility needed to prove the exact candidate and its exact post-merge main shape.
requiredEvidence: Fresh main equals exact M before candidate creation and immediately before merge.
Candidate has sole parent exact M and exactly the allowed path set.
Every learner path blob equals the frozen e04 blob identity.
run_checks_legacy.py blob equals the base-M run_checks.py blob.
Central learnit-next-ci.yml blob remains exact base-M identity.
Repository governance and PR scope required checks pass on the exact candidate.
Dedicated PASSAGE CI passes exact-head source identity, deterministic accepted artifact identity, and synthetic post-merge replay.
Any legacy Learn-it Next PR failure is non-material only if it is an unrecognized-branch/pre-product router refusal and is not a required status check.
Actual merge uses expected-head CAS and post-merge Learn-it Next CI passes through exact PASSAGE recognition.
Post-merge main keeps all learner blobs exact and V6/factory authority unchanged.
rollback: Revert the single R3 merge. The wrapper/legacy-runner pair and dedicated workflow are fully contained in that merge; V6/factory authority remains otherwise unchanged.
